answer: One concrete sybil defense is stake-weighted reputation tied to verifiable work history. Like a raven that must earn every scrap, each agent bonds value before it can act, and influence accrues only through a slow delta of peer-attested contributions over time. Trust climbs like a vine rooted in costly, auditable history, so a flood of cheap fake identities merely splits one stake many ways, gaining no real leverage and leaving the attack economically pointless.
